notes.title: Update 3.01
notes.notes:
You wanted it. And here it is, the new saving system.

Changes to the save system:

 5 Saveslots
 Direct display of the level and the current playing time.
 Shows the difficulty modes and number of players.

Unfortunately, old savegames can not be loaded.
Settings, enabled difficulty modes and the arcade machines
are kept.

https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/30e25bc859f675db63e74dffb7158949c0c64f32.jpg

Other changes:

New improved gamma adjustment for more visibility on poor displays.


https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/f7af3ce5508167080884d405f79278f548fc58c9.jpg

notes.title: The big 3.0 update is out now!
notes.notes:
https://steamcdn-a.akamaihd.net/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/a73be49f117e5164632712dfff77f13ccf2d664f.png

 Whats in this update?

Besides numerous smaller bugfixes and improvements there are:

 1 new extremely long level!
 2 new bosses!
 4 new enemy types!
 1 more unlockable arcade cabinet!
 The first usable vehicle!
 New light engine!
 Improved performance!

I am the boss! Raffle!

In order to thank our supporters, we have come up with a special raffle.

Would you like to fight the Jetbros as boss in the next level? Then take part in our raffle until 21.07.2018 by clicking on the participation button in the game menu.

notes.title: a little Update 2.61
notes.notes:
Added  

     New player animations when opening doors or using an arcade machine.

  Changed  

    The volume can now be adjusted more precisely.

  Bug Fixes   

    No more crashing on the arcade machine "Plasma Impact" when you are rammed by an opponent.
    The gametimer is no longer set to 0 if you use an arcade machine.
    The MG Robot: R01 can no longer be moved by other opponents.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/526d3ef4c8a6046d53e866b7c4e51d609c28cbd0.jpg

notes.title: Update 2.6+
notes.notes:
And here it is: THE NEXT UPDATE   

 This time we have something new to UNLOCK for you. We overhauled 1 or more levels. And, of course, we smashed some bugs. 


 Added: 

       The first unlockable game within the game is now UNLOCKABLE..

Find the hidden Arcade Cabinet and add it to your Arcade Center.
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/230bc1ef2f9eb16b744edccb4d8c2f8db025b084.png
Enough space for many games!

 Changes: 


       Level 2 has been extensively overhauled. 
       The damage of the rocket launcher has increased. 
       The return speed from the Loot Depot has speeded up.


 Bug Fixes:

       No more unwanted shooting when the Minitutorials are skipped. 
       Now, in the Coop mode, the 3rd boss starts again without errors.
       In the game, the mouse pointer is no longer visible.
       When the controller is used, the mouse pointer is no longer visible in the main menu. 
       In Coop mode, some humanoid opponents are no longer ignore the players. 
       Grenades do not disappear when they fly out of the screen.
       SteamCloud storage finally for all unlocked. Sorry we forgot to enable it :(  
       With the enemy shooting animation, now comes always a shot out of the gun.

notes.title: Update 2.6
notes.notes:
Today's update brings a few small improvements:

     In the menu you will find a new category for unlocked items.
 

And here are the first things you can unlock:

     3 additional difficulty modes. Can you manage to defeat the most difficult level?	

You are shooting the boss but does not know when he dies?

     Nun hat jeder Boss eine Lebensanzeige. http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/058d698ed494a31c2d281dad240aee60f732e284.jpg

Now every boss has a lifebar!

     New animations brings you closer to the gamemechanics.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/68c5855fc221e4ad5b5f05bea5ed93dd61fa4106.jpg
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/29492895/25acc0a941ba035a128e258dbd9e69b11c707ba6.jpg


Bugfixes

     After beating the german version, the language no longer changes to English.
